title: A/R: the three aging reports are in the Reports menu with their titles
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Find the "Finance" part of the left list.
  3. Click "A/R Aging Summary" under "Accounts Receivable".
  4. Read the page title and the page address.
  5. Click "A/R Aging Detail".
  6. Read the page title and the page address.
  7. Click "A/R Aging Collection".
  8. Read the page title and the page address.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 2:

  • under "Finance" there is an "Accounts Receivable" heading with A/R Aging Summary, A/R Aging Detail and A/R Aging Collection.

Step 4:

  • the title reads "A/R Aging Summary"; the address ends in /reports/ar-aging-summary.

Step 6:

  • the title reads "A/R Aging Detail"; the address ends in /reports/ar-aging-detail.

Step 8:

  • the title reads "A/R Aging Collection"; the address ends in /reports/ar-aging-collection.

Why this matters: Users must still find the receivables reports where they always were.
